title: Rediscovering Indian Traditional Crafts: Instilling Pride in Today’s Children
introduction: India’s traditional crafts carry stories, skills, and wisdom passed down generations. From Warli art to Bandhani textiles and Dhokra metalwork, these crafts reflect heritage, creativity, and resilience. Modern children often miss this connection due to screens and packaged entertainment.

benefits_for_children.connect_with_heritage: Stories behind crafts make history tangible, meaningful, and relatable.
benefits_for_children.appreciate_skills_and_creativity: Watching artisans or learning the process builds respect for patience and craftsmanship.
benefits_for_children.develop_cultural_pride: Hands-on learning fosters pride in roots and confidence in identity.
benefits_for_children.encourage_creativity_and_expression: Craft activities inspire experimentation and originality.

b2r_approach: Back to Roots brings Indian crafts alive through workshops, storytelling, and hands-on exploration. Children experience culture directly, building pride and emotional connection.
closing_note: Indian crafts are a legacy. Teaching them nurtures curiosity, creativity, and cultural pride, helping children build a strong sense of self.
